talents.name: Blue Leyline Attunement
talents.description: When you Draw Mana, gain an advantage on your next Cognitive test.

talents.name: Forewarned
talents.description: At the start of each round, silently declare one creature and one action type. If that creature takes the declared action before your next turn, you gain one Reaction.
talents.flavor: You saw this coming before they decided it.

talents.name: Intercept
talents.description: When a creature you designated with Forewarned takes the declared action, spend 1 Investiture to impose disadvantage on that action.

talents.name: Telepathic Network
talents.description: Spend 2 Investiture. You can communicate telepathically with characters within Attunement Range for the scene. Allies in the network share your expertise.

talents.name: Calculated Patience
talents.description: When you take a slow turn, your first test that turn gains advantage.

talents.name: Reactive Analysis
talents.description: Once per round, when a character within Attunement Range fails a test, gain an advantage on your next test against it.

talents.name: Probable Outcome
talents.description: After all characters choose fast or slow turn, you may change your choice.

talents.name: Read Intent
talents.description: Spend 1 Investiture and test Blue against a character within Attunement Range's Cognitive defense. On a success, the GM reveals what action that creature intends to take next round.

talents.name: Collected
talents.description: Increase your Cognitive and Spiritual defenses by 2.

talents.name: Subtle Suggestion
talents.description: When you successfully influence a character, spend 1 Investiture. The target also becomes Disoriented until the start of your next turn.
talents.flavor: The best manipulation feels like the target's own idea.

talents.name: Pattern Recognition
talents.description: When you successfully influence a character, that character has disadvantage on their next test to resist your influence this scene.

talents.name: Composed
talents.description: Increase your maximum focus by your tier.

talents.name: Counterspell
talents.description: When a character within Attunement Range spends Investiture to activate a talent, spend 1 Investiture to test Blue against their Cognitive defense. On a success, the talent fails.

talents.name: Anticipate
talents.description: When you or an ally in your Telepathic Network would be targeted by an influence effect, spend 1 Investiture to give that creature an advantage on their resistance test.

talents.name: False Premise
talents.description: When a creature within Attunement Range succeeds on a Cognitive test, impose disadvantage on its next test. Once per round.

talents.name: Probability Cascade
talents.description: Spend an Opportunity and 1 Investiture to give a character within Attunement Range disadvantage on its next two tests.

talents.name: Baleful
talents.description: To resist your Influence, a creature must spend additional focus equal to your tier.

talents.name: Redirect Momentum
talents.description: When a character within Attunement Range moves, spend 1 Investiture to test Blue vs. Physical. On a success, reduce its remaining movement by [Size] or push it [Size] ft in any direction.

talents.name: Phantom Step
talents.description: When an ally within Attunement Range moves, spend 1 Investiture. They may move an additional [Size] feet without provoking reactions.

talents.name: Holographic Illusion
talents.description: Spend 1 Investiture to create an illusion within Attunement Range, not exceeding [Size]. Use a Free Action to make minor adjustments to it.

talents.name: Phantom Barricade
talents.description: Spend 1 Investiture to create a shimmering barrier at a point within Attunement Range. It has health equal to 2[Die] and lasts for the scene or until destroyed. The barricade provides cover and blocks movement.

talents.name: Ghostly Walls
talents.description: Choose a character you can influence within Attunement Range and spend 1 Investiture. Test Blue vs. Cognitive. On success, the target's Speed becomes 0 until end of your next turn.

talents.name: Living Image
talents.description: Your illusions can move up to your movement rate and interact with the environment. Use an Action to have your illusion perform something requiring your attention, such as a conversation. Complex illusions cost 1 Investiture per round to maintain.

talents.name: Absolute Stillness
talents.description: Creatures you have reduced to 0 Speed have disadvantage on Physical tests and cannot take Reactions.

talents.name: Phantom Double
talents.description: Spend 2 Investiture. Create an illusory duplicate of yourself or an ally within Attunement Range. Enemy characters test Perception against Blue. On a failure, they treat it as real. Attacks targeting it pass through harmlessly, ending the illusion. While it persists, the duplicated creature gains an advantage against characters that failed the test.
talents.flavor: Which one is real? Neither. Both. Does it matter?
